title: KTU 2024 Scheme Activity Points Regulation
description: Official rules for APJ Abdul Kalam Technological University Activity Points System under 2024 Curriculum Scheme (B.Tech, B.Des, BBA & BCA)

regular.description: 4-Year Regular Degree under 2024 NEP Regulation (Minimum 120 activity points, at least 40 points from each of the 3 Activity Groups for 3 Activity Credits)

lateral.description: B.Tech Lateral Entry under 2024 Regulation joining Semester 3 (Minimum 90 activity points, at least 30 points from each of the 3 Activity Groups)

pwd.description: Persons with Disabilities (PwD) students under 2024 Regulation (Minimum 60 activity points, at least 20 points from each of the 3 Activity Groups)

generalRules: Participation points and winning points cannot be combined for the same event. If a student wins a position, only the points for winning will be awarded.
The highest level of achievement attained will be considered (e.g. winning at College level then State level -> State level counted).
Each activity/category has a maximum point limit specified in the Activity Points Table.
A total of 3 Activity Credits is mandatory for the award of the Degree (1 credit per group).
Activity Points and Activity Credits are not included in SGPA/CGPA calculation.
Only activities completed during the period of study of the programme are eligible. Certificates obtained before joining are NOT considered.
Submission of fake or fraudulent documents results in cancellation of awarded points and disciplinary action.
